Whether you’re looking to promote brand awareness or boost your organic traffic, having kick-ass, informative blog articles and optimized SEO content on your site is imperative. And, like most things with digital marketing, that can be tougher than it looks. SEO content writing is a nuanced art — but there’s a science to it as well. That’s where HawkSEM comes in. Digital marketing is a little bit of both, and if you’re looking for a partner to help take your enterprise or small business to the next level, working with a content writing service can certainly help you get there. What is SEO Content? SEO content is anything that will help your web pages rank higher on search engine results pages (SERPs). This includes basically everything to do with the content on your website and the structure of that content. According to our good friends at Yoast , there are three main elements to consider when creating really good SEO content: 1. Keyword research 2. Site structure 3. Copywriting Let’s take a closer look at each of these in turn. 1. Keyword research When doing keyword research, you’re essentially looking for a list of terms that your prospective customers are searching for and terms that you want to rank for. In this stage, you also need to keep search intent in mind. If your prospects are looking for the best live jazz clubs in New Orleans, keyword researchers need to consider how a potential patron will conduct that search. 2. Site structure Site structure is not just about making your website look pretty and sticking to your brand voice. A good-looking but disorganized website is frustrating to navigate, not to mention not very useful to potential customers. Aside from creating a more cohesive user experience, a good site structure helps search engines “understand” your site. A well-organized site makes it easier for Google and the like to sort out the most important content on your website and index it accordingly. As you build your website content, you’ll likely find that a lot of your article topics are very similar to each other. Good site structure coupled with detailed keyword research helps ensure that you’re not competing with your own content for those higher SERP rankings. 3. Copywriting So you’ve got the technical stuff down. The final and perhaps most important aspect of good SEO content is making your articles engaging and informative so that people will want to stay on your site. After all, you’re doing all of this to reach potential customers. This is where content services can be extremely helpful. Search engine optimization (SEO) itself has changed a lot since the dawn of search engines. Something that worked really well in years past will probably not work as well now — even something that worked last week may not yield the results you want. These coveted top search engine rankings on Google, Bing, or Yahoo results pages are not easy to snag, that’s why many companies have entire teams consistently working on their site’s optimization efforts to ensure that their solution is one of the first that comes up. Long form content articles are more in-depth (over 1,500), and usually target keywords that cover a larger topic, such as “paid search” or “SEO”. Blog articles help your SEO by being high-quality, relevant, and helpful to users. Social content, when optimized for social search engines, helps people find your company on social media platforms. Evergreen content is exactly what it sounds like — search-optimized content that stays “fresh” for a long period of time. Evergreen content is long, in-depth, informative, and optimized. Data-led content is consistently fresh and reliable, using up-to-date data to help demonstrate industry trends. A strategic approach focuses on creating the right pages, not more pages, supported by keyword mapping and content prioritization. How Is SEO Content Writing Different From SEO Blog Writing? SEO content writing includes all on-site content created to rank in search, such as service pages, product pages, and resource content.
